citation: Each row is cited to its document in the bibliography block of Chapter 43 (references_zh.tex): zv1962, lenkom1962, frus1947, frus1970, res1981, nbs1999, nbs2000, mqy2010, smil1999, kornai1980, kornai1986, kmr2003, zv1965, worldbank1978yu, yusuf1977, loc43, gnd43. The table A8 of Meng, Qian and Yared (rows a8_*) reproduces Li and Yang (2005), whose source is the Ministry of Agriculture (1989): it is cited as Meng, Qian and Yared's table, not to Li and Yang, which was not read.
notes: Every quotation is copied from the text layer of the document as data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py extracts it (pdftotext with and without -layout, tags removed from web pages, whitespace and Unicode compatibility forms normalized), so the misreadings of the scans stay in the quotations; the rows say what each misreading stands for. The scans of Kornai (1980) and Kornai (1986) have no text layer, and the text layer of Заря Востока of 1 October 1965 splits its words into letters; their rows, the masthead of Заря Востока of 1 June 1962 (row zv62_masthead) and the dates of the Leningrad scan (row lk_scan_dates) were read on page images rendered with pdftoppm (with tesseract's OCR as a draft); their transcriptions are in the notes between « and », and a reviewer checks them by eye. The numbers of these rows were read on the images: the steel qualities 10, 11 and 9 of Kornai (1980) pp. 36-37, the year 1968 of p. 3; the 1755 firms, table 1 (0.91 and 1.27 for 1982) and table 3 (the rows of the loss-makers and of the high-profitability firms) of Kornai (1986) pp. 14-17; the date 29 сентября 1965 and the issue number of Заря Востока; 17 and 31 May on the Leningrad scan. The text layers misread: 'ПАТИЙНЫХ' for 'ПАРТИЙНЫХ' (lk_number), 'Г.И,' for 'Г.И.' (lk_addressee); the transcription on istmat.org keeps the typewriter's capital 'I' for the digit '1' (lk_date, lk_dates), as the scan prints it (row lk_scan_dates); 'иСовета' for 'и Совета' (zv62_title) and 'миллионов'800' for 'миллионов 800' (zv62_output) in Заря Востока; 'rail' for 'retail' (fr47_single) and 'geater' for 'greater' (fr47_sacrifice) as FRUS prints the telegram; 'bad can weather' for 'bad weather' (mqy_weather) as the working paper prints it; the layout text of table A-1 spaces many decimals, '20. 86' for '20.86' (nbs_1960, and so in other rows nbs_*); 'Challen1rs of Develonment' for 'Challenges of Development' (wb78_title), 'hb' for 'be' (wb78_restricted), 'thpir' for 'their' (wb78_purpose), 'noliries, ramainpd' for 'policies, remained' (wb78_state), 'Tne' and ';964' for 'The' and '1964' (wb78_1965, the page image reads 'between 1964 and 1967'), 'FNANCE STUDI2S' for 'FINANCE STUDIES' (yu_series). The Russian newspaper prints decimal commas ('91,6'), read as decimal points. In table A-1 of the 1999 compilation the column headed 农业 prints the smaller numbers (9441 in 1949) and the one headed 非农业 the larger (44726), in every year: the heads look interchanged, and the chapter does not use these two columns (row nbs_1949). The text layer of table A-1 reads '33462' for '33469' (nbs_1957), the men of 1957 as the page image prints them (33469 + 31184 = 64653); the chapter does not use that column. In table A-1 the death rate of 1969 is printed 8.63 (nbs_1969), as the page image shows; the birth rate 34.11 less the rate of natural increase 26.08 of the same row gives 8.03, so one of the three is misprinted; the figure draws the death rate as printed and the text does not use the year. The scan of the compilation on scalar.usc.edu is a third-party copy, read to verify the official numbers; the five years that table 4-2 of the 2000 yearbook also gives agree with it (rows nb2_*). The famine years 1958-1961 are not in table 4-2. Meng, Qian and Yared (2010) is the NBER working paper, not the article of 2015 in the Review of Economic Studies, which was not read; their table A8 reproduces Li and Yang (2005), 24 provinces; their footnote 19 gives Li and Yang's retention after procurement as 223 kg per person in 1959, on another basis than the table's 193 kg per agricultural labourer (rows mqy_fn19, a8_1959). Their page 1 gives 17 to 30 million deaths, their data appendix 16.5 to 30 million (rows mqy_range, mqy_five). Kornai (1980) is volume A only (volume B was not read). The landing pages of the World Bank render their metadata by script; their static HTML gives only the title. The chargé's 275 per cent for bread (row fr47_bread) is 278 per cent by his two prices. The life dates of G. I. Popov, the addressee of the Leningrad report, were not found in an authority record: the text says 生卒年未详.
